source: recorded during a probe of the live account on 2026-09-08, in a private repository that is not published here. Real response, transcribed verbatim from that record; this repository cannot re-observe it, because the write path needs a whitelisted static IP the probing machine does not have. Section on error codes not being diagnostic.
why_it_matters: The order path's hard stop. Note the code is DH-905, the SAME code returned for 'quantity is required' below -- so an IP failure can only be told apart by its MESSAGE.
